summary.headline: Refutation of Astrological Necessity
summary.text: Theological refutation of astrology argues that stars are indicative rather than necessary causes of earthquakes, conflagrations, civic fortunes, faith, and military invulnerability. It invokes David, Basil’s funeral oration, Dionysius’s discussion of the eclipse at Christ’s Passion, and Valens’s astrological claims.
